## Project Overview

This is a modern AI chat web application built with Next.js, TypeScript, and Tailwind CSS. The application features:

- Professional UI inspired by ChatGPT and Gemini with pastel color scheme
- Firebase authentication (login/signup)
- Main chat interface with sidebar
- Payment integration
- AI GPT-4o backend integration
- Food database for fitness features

## Design Guidelines

- Use soft pastel colors for a professional, gentle appearance
- Follow modern UI/UX patterns similar to ChatGPT and Gemini
- Implement responsive design for all screen sizes
- Use Tailwind CSS utility classes for styling
- Maintain consistent spacing and typography

## Technical Stack

- **Framework**: Next.js 14+ with App Router
- **Language**: TypeScript
- **Styling**: Tailwind CSS
- **Authentication**: Firebase Auth
- **Database**: Firebase Firestore
- **AI Integration**: OpenAI GPT-4o API
- **Payment**: Stripe integration

## Code Style

- Use TypeScript for all components and utilities
- Follow React best practices with hooks and functional components
- Implement proper error handling and loading states
- Use server-side rendering where appropriate
- Maintain clean, readable code with proper commenting
